# Myfx - Full API Reference

## Overview

Myfx is a modular utility library with 200+ pure functions. Written in TypeScript with lazy evaluation support. Zero dependencies.

## Installation

```sh
npm install myfx
```

## Import Options

```ts
// Default import (full library)
import _ from 'myfx'

// Named imports (subpath exports like myfx/collection removed in v2.0.0)
import { each, map, filter, debounce, throttle } from 'myfx'

// CDN
import _ from 'https://cdn.skypack.dev/myfx'
```

---

## Collection Module

### each(collection, iteratee)
Iterate over collection, calling iteratee for each element.

```ts
_.each([1, 2, 3], (item, index) => console.log(item, index))
_.each({ a: 1, b: 2 }, (value, key) => console.log(key, value))
```

### map(collection, iteratee)
Transform each element using iteratee.

```ts
_.map([1, 2, 3], (item) => item * 2) // [2, 4, 6]
_.map({ a: 1, b: 2 }, (v, k) => v * 2) // { a: 2, b: 4 }
```

### filter(collection, predicate)
Filter elements matching predicate.

```ts
_.filter([1, 2, 3, 4], (item) => item % 2 === 0) // [2, 4]
```

### reduce(collection, accumulator, initial)
Reduce collection to single value.

```ts
_.reduce([1, 2, 3], (acc, item) => acc + item, 0) // 6
```

### find(collection, predicate)
Find first element matching predicate.

```ts
_.find([1, 2, 3], (item) => item > 1) // 2
```

### every(collection, predicate)
Check if all elements match.

```ts
_.every([1, 2, 3], (item) => item > 0) // true
```

### some(collection, predicate)
Check if any element matches.

```ts
_.some([1, 2, 3], (item) => item > 2) // true
```

### flatMap(collection, iteratee)
Map and flatten result.

### flatten(collection, [depth])
Flatten nested arrays.

### unique(collection)
Remove duplicates.

### compact(collection)
Remove falsy values.

### head(collection)
Get first element.

### tail(collection)
Get all but first element.

### last(collection)
Get last element.

### size(collection)
Get collection size.

### includes(collection, value)
Check if value exists.

### difference(array, ...values)

### intersection(...arrays)

### union(...arrays)

Remove specified values.

### zip(...arrays)

### unzip(array)

### flattenDeep(array)

### orderBy(collection, iteratees, orders)
Sort by multiple criteria.

### groupBy(collection, iteratee)
Group elements by key.

### keyBy(collection, iteratee)
Index by key.

### uniqBy(collection, iteratee)
Remove duplicates by iteratee.

## Types

```ts
type Collection<T> = T[] | Record<string, T>
type Iteratee<T, R> = (value: T, key: any, collection: Collection<T>) => R
type Predicate<T> = (value: T, index: any, collection: Collection<T>) => boolean
```
